infobox.title: પ્રાઇવેસી સ્ટૈક
infobox.imageCaption: GL.iNet router કે સાથ AdGuard Home running નેટવર્ક-વ્યાપી DNS ફ઼િલ્ટરિંગ

lead:
મેરે **પ્રાઇવેસી સ્ટૈક** is એક પરતદાર વ્યક્તિગત ગોપનીયતા ઔર સુરક્ષા સેટઅપ spanning OS hardening, બ્રાઉજ઼ર fingerprint resistance, hardware-level નેટવર્ક filtering, self-hosted services, ઔર planned email migration. It currently sits at approximately **85% પૂર્ણતા** — the main remaining gap is Gmail, which I haven't yet migrated to a ગોપનીયતા-respecting provider.

I've built the entire stack on free ઔર open source software, which connects philosophically to [[foss-coin|FOSS Coin]] ઔર the broader FOSS-first approach documented in મેરે [[about|profile]]. Every layer is either already deployed or has a concrete plan કે લિએ deployment through મેરે [[homelab|Libre Cloud homelab]].

content.content:
The OS layer is the foundation. Running **Arch Linux via [[linux-setup|Omarchy]]** gives me the most control over what software is installed ઔર what runs in the background. Hyprland Wayland tiling WM has minimal background services by design — compared to a typical desktop environment, the attack surface ઔર telemetry footprint are dramatically reduced.

Key decisions I made at this layer:
- **Chromium removed** (telemetry) — replaced કે સાથ LibreWolf
- **Spotify removed** (tracking) — no replacement
- **MAC address randomisation** enabled on all નેટવર્ક interfaces
- **Fork control**: I maintain a personal ગિટહબ fork of Omarchy to selectively apply upstream changes on મેરે own terms

content.title: મેરા વિશ્વાસ મૉડલ
content.content: Arch packages flow through the Arch pacman ecoસિસ્ટમ, not DHH's servers. Even using Omarchy, the underlying package signatures ઔર build infrastructure remain the Arch Linux પરિયોજના's — not a third party's.

મૈં ઉપયોગ કરતા હૂઁ **LibreWolf** — a Firefox fork કે સાથ hardened anti-fingerprinting defaults applied out of the box. Key differences from stock Firefox that I care about:
- `resistFingerprinting` enabled by default — canvas, WebGL, audio, timezone, ઔર font fingerprinting are all blocked
- No telemetry or crash reporting sent to Mozilla
- Stricter cookie defaults ઔર cross-site isolation

**uBlock Origin** runs on top of LibreWolf in medium mode — blocking all third-party scripts ઔર frames by default, કે સાથ manual allowlist rules I've added over time કે લિએ sites that require scripts to function.

I also explored Firefox Multi-Account Containers કે લિએ session isolation per site category (banking in one container, social media in another, shopping in another).

content.title: જ્ઞાત વિશેષતા — ડાર્ક થીમ
content.content: LibreWolf's resistFingerprinting setting can break dark mode rendering on some sites. Fix: toggle resistFingerprinting off ઔર on in about:config to restore correct theming. I've hit this a few times.
The DNS layer is the most technically layered part of મેરે stack — મૈં ચલાતા હૂઁ multiple filtering સિસ્ટમs at different levels:

rows.दायरा: AdGuard Home on home subnet — blocks ads/malware કે લિએ all devices on મેરે home નેટવર્ક
Custom profile કે સાથ telemetry blocking
Ads + Trackers + Malware filtering on મેરે laptop ઔર phone
યોજિત — will encrypt traffic from device to homelab exit node

content.title: કૉલેજ WiFi બાધા
content.content: SonicWALL SSL inspection on the college WiFi blocks pacman package downloads. મેરે workaround: mobile hotspot કે લિએ સિસ્ટમ updates on campus.

rows.स्थिति: ❌ લંબિત — મેરા મુખ્ય અંતર. Custom domain contact@lingadevaru.in active.
✅ Live — no fingerprinting, no Google Analytics on any site I own
